analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape was dominated by JPY strength, with USD/JPY closing -82.6 pips and CHF/JPY -108.0 pips, despite no clean catalyst owning the move. NZD was the weakest major, with NZD/USD -20.3 pips and a mean_vs_majors_pct of -0.405%. Risk appetite firmed: SPX closed +14.7 points, VIX -6.0 points, and Brent +67.7 pips. Late RBA Hunter comments favored a hawkish repricing, contributing to AUD/NZD gains and a partial USD/JPY bounce.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Three small legs (down 5.3, up 11.8, down 8.3) left EUR/USD in a 13.4-pip range, closing at 1.16247 with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: Four alternating legs (down 10.5, up 14.7, down 14.2, up 5.2) left GBP/USD -6.9 pips at 1.35395, with no leg owned by a specific release.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: A 14.4-pip down leg to 04:30 was partially reversed by an 8.2-pip up leg after Hunter comments, closing -3.4 pips at 0.72166.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: An 11.5-pip up leg gave way to a 24.9-pip down leg that closed the session at 0.58588, weakest major.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: A 128.0-pip decline dominated until 04:15, then a 43.9-pip bounce left USD/JPY -82.6 pips at 153.468 without a clean catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: Five small legs with a net +2.6 pips left USD/CHF at 0.80929; most legs had no owner and stayed within a 13.6-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: A 16.1-pip down leg from 21:30 to 03:45 was only partly retraced, closing -7.0 pips at 1.3803 near the low of its 17.9-pip range.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: Eight small legs left EUR/CHF nearly unchanged at 0.94077, with several flow-only legs and a tight 8.2-pip range.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: The 153.0-pip down leg to 04:15 was retraced by 45.9 pips, closing -108.0 pips at 189.623 as JPY strength overwhelmed CHF.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: A 17.4-pip down leg at the open reversed into a 54.5-pip up leg, closing +36.7 pips at 1.23167 as RBA repricing outweighed NZD weakness.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: Three legs (down 4.1, up 8.6, down 2.7) left EUR/GBP +1.7 pips at 0.85857, still inside a 10.8-pip range.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: A 11.2-pip down leg into 04:15 reversed to an 8.7-pip up leg after Hunter, closing -1.0 pips at 0.58401.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: A 9.9-pip up leg was followed by a 17.9-pip down leg, closing -14.9 pips at 0.47412 and reflecting NZD underperformance.
leg_notes.USD/SEK: Five alternating legs ended +105.5 pips at 9.5968, with the final 110.9-pip up leg pushing close to the top of a 151.9-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/NOK: Six choppy legs left USD/NOK -49.2 pips at 9.26229, with a 138.0-pip down leg at 21:30 providing the main move.
leg_notes.USD/ZAR: Six whippy legs left USD/ZAR -53.6 pips at 15.98479, with a 337.8-pip down leg at 20:15 and a 264.6-pip up leg at 23:30 dominating a 365.1-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/MXN: A 729.1-pip up leg through the Asia morning was partly retraced by a 278.9-pip down leg, closing +257.7 pips at 16.94971.
leg_notes.Brent/USD: A 56.8-pip up leg to 23:00 was followed by a 39.3-pip pullback and a 44.2-pip recovery, closing +67.7 pips at 99.543 with a 0.96 close_in_range.

polarity_reads.event: Hunter: RBA board may need to raise rates if inflation appears set to intensify
polarity_reads.read: Measured leg attribution shows AUD/NZD gained +25.1 pips in 15 minutes (46% of the up leg) and AUD/USD gained +4.3 pips (52% of its up leg), implying a hawkish RBA repricing; no inverted reaction observed.

scenarios.name: JPY strength extends
scenarios.thesis: JPY is the strongest major with mean_vs_majors_pct +0.603, and USD/JPY and CHF/JPY fell without a clear catalyst, pointing to flow-driven demand that can persist in the absence of countervailing US data.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers above 153.468 or Tokyo verbal intervention emerges.

pair_paths.rationale: Repeat of the overnight USD/JPY decline, the largest single-pair move of the session.
CHF/JPY showed even larger overnight loss than USD/JPY, consistent with broad JPY outperformance.

scenarios.name: Hawkish RBA supports AUD/NZD
scenarios.thesis: Hunter's RBA comments were the only measurable leg driver, adding +25.1 pips to AUD/NZD (46% of the up leg), and AUD/NZD closed +36.7 pips; continued RBA repricing should keep AUD bid against NZD.
scenarios.invalidation: AUD/NZD falls back below 1.23167 or RBA pushes back against tightening.

pair_paths.rationale: Overnight AUD/NZD gain reflects measured Hunter contribution and RBA divergence.
Last AUD/USD up leg after Hunter was 8.2 pips, and hawkish spillover can extend that move.
NZD was the weakest major overnight with NZD/USD -20.3 pips and close_in_range only 0.24.

scenarios.name: Consolidation after overnight extremes
scenarios.thesis: After a 149.7-pip USD/JPY range, Brent close near its high, and SPX near its range high, the market may pause before the GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings.
scenarios.invalidation: Breakout beyond the overnight ranges on fresh headlines.

pair_paths.rationale: The last USD/JPY up leg was 43.9 pips, offering a measured bounce in a mean-reverting tape.
EUR/USD's overnight range was only 13.4 pips, with close_in_range 0.27 signaling indecision.
Brent's 284.4-pip range leaves scope for consolidation after closing near its high at 99.543.

risks.why_it_matters: JPY and AUD moves were driven by flows and repricing without a clear catalyst, leaving them exposed to verbal intervention or yield repricing.
risks.watch: USD/JPY 153.468 and its 149.7-pip range; RBA speakers after Hunter.

risks.why_it_matters: It is the only scheduled event ahead and can reprice GBP, spilling into EUR/GBP and GBP/USD.
Brent closed with a 0.96 close_in_range after +0.685%, leaving limited room before profit taking that could hit CAD, NOK, and risk sentiment.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: The only scheduled item ahead is GBP Monetary Policy Report Hearings at 15:15 (Medium); before that, no tier-1 US or Asia data are on deck, so flow and headline risk remain dominant.
